cmd:diagnostics.note: :diagnostics (:diag) opens a read-only overlay with the desktop's own measurements (daemon round trip, frame interval, sessions listed, daemon connection) in place of the TUI's RSI_PROFILE render, poll and cache metrics

key:<Space>K.note: <Space>K opens the scheduled jobs browser (also View › Scheduled jobs…)

module:ui/overlay/mcp_server_form.rs.note: MCP servers list (a add, Enter/e edit, t enable, s set / r rotate / d clear the write-only credential, R refresh) and the definition form; secret-looking arguments and URL user-info are masked before the webview (ListMcpServers, UpsertMcpServer, SetMcpServerEnabled, Set/Rotate/ClearMcpServerSecret)

overlay-ref:diagnostics.note: q/Esc close, r measures again, Space N / Space ; as in the TUI; desktop metrics replace the TUI's render/poll/cache rows

overlay-ref:schedule-form.note: Tab fields, Left/Right cycles recurrence, Enter saves, Esc returns to the browser; create also takes an optional working directory, provider and model (the TUI uses its cwd and launch selection); edit sends name, message and schedule as the TUI does (CreateScheduledJob, UpdateScheduledJob)

overlay-ref:scheduled-jobs-browser.note: j/k, n new, Enter/e edit, Space enable or disable, t run now, dd delete, r refresh, H history, m more, q/Esc; held wakes and wake mode shown per row (ListScheduledJobs, ListScheduledJobHolds, ToggleScheduledJob, TriggerScheduledJob, DeleteScheduledJob)

overlay-ref:source-worktree-settlement.note: View › Source-worktree settlement…: j/k J/K select (a selection change drops the audit), Enter audits, A begins authorization, r refreshes the receipt, Esc/q, Space N / Space ; (ListSourceWorktreeCohorts, AuditSourceWorktreeCohort, ListSourceWorktreeSettlementRuns, ApplySourceWorktreeCohort)

overlay:legacy-scratch-adoption.note: View › Legacy scratch adoption…: each unrecorded directory with the daemon's verdict; a/Enter or A (at most 32 adoptable) open a confirmation listing every full path and nothing is sent until y; Esc/n/q cancel; r refresh (ListLegacyScratch, AdoptLegacyScratch)

overlay:remote-settings.note: View › Remote access…: status block (URL, gateway, serve route, funnel, tailscale, the one-time serve command), Tab devices/projects, Space/Enter allow or expose (max 32 projects), e enable, n answers, m messages, a re-converge, r refresh, q/Esc (RemoteGetStatus, RemoteSetConfig)

overlay:satellite-registry-browser.note: View › Satellite registry…: Tab peers/links/cached sessions, j/k, a/e add or edit, d enable or disable (disabling a peer also clears reads and dispatch), R quarantine repair edit, p probe, I inbound policy, n/b session pages, r refresh, q/Esc; peer saves send the scope at the new revision as the TUI does (ListSatellitePeers, GetSatelliteScopeStatus, Get/PutSatelliteInboundPolicy, PutSatellitePeer, PutSatellitePeerScope, PutSatelliteLink, ProbeSatelliteLink, ListHubSatelliteSessions)

overlay:source-worktree-settlement-autho.note: only after a fresh applyable audit of the selected cohort; the phrase is typed, never prefilled, and Apply runs only on an exact match (checked again in the Tauri backend); Esc leaves and clears it; one desktop-<uuid> retry key per authorization
